info.title: FeedMe production API contract
info.description: Build contract with Supabase backend/auth direction approved 2026-09-15; no service is deployed. Android and iOS share Kotlin domain/network/UI. Supabase credentials and store purchases are native/provider operations outside this API. Examples and operational limits require configured release validation. See companion architecture/data/privacy docs for authorization, retention and transaction invariants. Public identifiers do not grant access.

get.summary: Read current guest session without renewal
get.description: Operational guest lifecycle verification, not an additional product feature. Requires the exact opaque guest bearer and current guest root, policy, admission and expiry checks in one owned transaction. Never accepts an account bearer, device header, caller-selected identity, query, body, idempotency or conditional request. Does not renew idle or absolute expiry, issue credentials or expose a token or private principal. Metadata describes the final checked server state; it is not a portable authorization grant or an offline lease. No-store response.

post.summary: Idempotently provision app account and registered device session
post.description: Idempotently provision the FeedMe account and registered device session from an independently verified provider subject and current identity policy. Never derive an account, display name or handle from unverified email or provider metadata. A new account returns a versioned pending Profile with displayName and handle both absent, onboardingStep=profile and the profile gate required. Completing that profile is a separate authorized update; pending onboarding is not social eligibility. The returned sessionId is a FeedMe device session, not the Supabase JWT session_id. Object authorization is evaluated at execution time; do not infer access from a client button or identifier. Persist the command key/result and domain mutation atomically; duplicate retry returns the original result while current authority still permits delivery.

get.summary: Read current registered account readiness without replaying bootstrap
get.description: Read the current profile, required gates, feature flags and entitlements for the exact registered FeedMe device bound to the verified provider subject and session. Recheck current provider, account, device and identity policy under the same transaction before returning. This read is independent of bootstrap command receipt retention and must not provision an account, replace a device, accept terms, advance onboarding, issue a command receipt or renew any authority. Nonempty requiredGates and non-ready profiles are observations, not private access. Flags and entitlements do not substitute for operation-specific authorization. No body, query, Idempotency-Key, If-Match, If-None-Match or ETag is supported.

get.summary: Read current account Terms notice without accepting it
get.description: Authenticated observation of the current configured Terms notice and this account's accepted version. Rechecks current provider/account/device/policy. A read or required=false is not consent, age eligibility, or private readiness. Published notice versions must be immutable; no body, query, command key, conditional headers, or ETag. noticeSha256 binds UTF-8 JSON array [termsVersion,termsUrl,privacyUrl] using SHA-256; it is not a remote document-content hash. Approved notice versions and their documents must remain immutable.

Never changes eligibility, onboarding, device binding, passwords, or private-session readiness. Client must retain and acknowledge the exact original before dispatch; unknown outcomes are reconciled using that original, never a replacement key. No If-Match or ETag.

post.summary: Reserve a quarantined upload for the selected protocol
post.description: Reserve a quarantined upload under current account, registered-device, terms, upload-policy and owner-scoped clientDraft lifecycle checks. Persist the exact command key, reservation, selected protocol and unchanged core Upload result atomically. Omitting MediaPrepare.protocol selects the historical versioned POST protocol: uploadUrl/uploadMethod/uploadFields/uploadExpiresAt are one ephemeral capability, and an authorized exact-key retry may freshly issue those fields only for the same unchanged awaitingUpload reservation without changing its media ID, version/ETag, timestamps, destination, expected bytes/type/checksum or original deadline. Explicit supabaseSignedUploadV1 selects a nested uploadCapability for raw PUT. It is issued at most once for that reservation; an exact-key retry after issuance returns the original core only and never signs another capability, including after a lost issuance response. Status GET never issues or renews any capability. Changed, processing or deleted reservations cannot receive capabilities. Expired legacy reservations and expired fresh capability issuance return 410 without allocating another media record. Only an exact Supabase prepare replay within its original seven-day command receipt lifetime may recover the unchanged awaitingUpload/version1 core after reservation expiry, including when the reservation committed before any issuance intent. This recovery still requires all current account, device, terms, upload-policy and same eligible draft-generation checks, exact original core equality and the configured protocol/bucket; it never creates an issuance intent, mints a capability or extends any deadline. Revoked or upload-disabled authority and expired command receipts remain refusals, not recovery or permission to allocate a replacement. Already-issued capabilities may remain usable until their actual provider expiry. Tombstones deny processing/publication and exact quarantine cleanup accounts for late uploads. A core-only response is not permission to upload or allocate a replacement. Upload acceptance alone grants no media delivery or publication rights.

The server reads the exact reserved quarantine destination and verifies the full bounded bytes, type and digest before retaining content-bound inspection material; a PUT Key acknowledgement, token, ETag or latest-object lookup alone is insufficient. Duplicate exact-key retry returns the original processing result, not a new upload capability or current ready status. Neither completion nor inspection grants delivery, attachment or publication authority.

UserBearer.description: Verify signature using configured issuer-bound public JWKS and an explicitly allowed asymmetric algorithm; validate exact issuer, authenticated audience, exp, iat, optional nbf, UUID sub and session_id, supported aal, role=authenticated and is_anonymous=false. Reject Google/Apple ID tokens, refresh tokens, anonymous/service-role keys and workforce credentials. A valid JWT proves provider identity only: current FeedMe account/device status, onboarding, email-confirmation/recovery policy and object permissions are checked separately. Never trust editable user metadata as eligibility or link accounts by email. Require the independently registered FeedMe app session except during bootstrap; Supabase session_id is not X-Device-Session.

GuestBearer.description: Bounded guest principal only on operations expressly permitting guest. Never interchangeable with user or staff role.

StaffBearer.description: Separate workforce identity/app client, MFA and least-privilege role; consumer JWT rejected.

WebhookAuthorization.name: Authorization
WebhookAuthorization.description: Configured RevenueCat webhook secret header. Also require enabled raw-body HMAC header and 5-minute freshness; see receiver description.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: UUID per logical durable command; scoped to principal+operation, request hash checked, result retained 7 days. Reuse on retries. Same key with different body returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_MISMATCH.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: ETag from latest representation, e.g. "7". Missing 428, stale 412. Deleting a missing owned object is idempotent only for the same recorded command.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque principal/filter-bound keyset cursor. Never treated as authorization.

Profile.description: A versioned one-to-one FeedMe account profile. Its id is the independently generated FeedMe account UUID, not a provider subject or private-storage principal ID. During initial onboardingStep=profile, displayName and handle may be absent together; neither is fabricated from provider data. If either is present, both must satisfy their unchanged constraints. Both are required for preferences, equipment and ready. Eligibility is an independent policy field; pending profile/onboarding never grants social access.

onboardingDecision.description: Explicit decision for the optional prompt being left. Request-only command metadata: never a Profile field, preference mutation, consent or eligibility grant. Answered binds the exact account-owned preferences revision explicitly reviewed; skipped changes no preference values. Required only when advancing preferences to equipment or equipment to ready.

inactivityExpiresAt.description: Unchanged idle expiry; this read does not extend it.

serverTime.description: Database time at the final current-state validation, not a future authorization guarantee.

replacesDeviceSessionId.description: Explicit same-account reconnection target. Must be submitted with replacementConsentVersion. Never inferred from installationId, and never authorizes another active device.

replacementConsentVersion.description: Exact server-configured reconnection notice intentionally confirmed by the user. This is separate from terms or eligibility and requires current server-verified fresh password authentication.

reviewStatus.description: approved is an independent review result; separate publish operation exposes content

estimateBasis.description: creatorReported applies only to personal community attachments and never confers professional review; reviewed versions use reviewerEstimate or supported pilotObserved evidence.
creatorReported applies only to personal community attachments and never confers professional review; reviewed versions use reviewerEstimate or supported pilotObserved evidence.

maxCleanupMinutes.description: Optional cleanup limit in minutes. When present, a meal requires a supported cleanup estimate at or below this limit; omission leaves cleanup unconstrained.

householdConsentRevision.description: Server-issued opaque revision of selected members' consent; carries no private exclusions.

PlanRequest.description: mode=improve requires baseMeal; auto resolves to a supported cook/assemble/improve mode and is not a stored Plan mode. Choose at most one source reference; server rejects ambiguous source IDs. Unknown base-meal ingredients never become safety assertions.

mode.description: Resolved preparation mode. Required for ready/recalled plans; may be omitted for needsConfirmation/noMatch when no concrete mode has been selected. Absence is not auto, null, or permission to cook.

continuationCursor.description: Signed owner+request+constraint-version-bound candidate traversal cursor; expires after proposed 10 minutes.

FeedbackWrite.description: Explicit user feedback only. Exactly one consistent target; if cookSessionId and target both supplied they must refer to the same owned cook. Require at least one taste, effort, makeAgain or note signal at service boundary.

nextItemCursor.description: Absent means a legacy complete savedRecipeIds set. Present null means the terminal item page. Present string means continue with getCollection cursor and the same collection version. listCollections embeds a bounded first item page per collection; its outer nextCursor pages collections, not their items. Never interpret a nonterminal item page as the complete collection.

Audience.description: Client selects circleIds; server derives/stamps bindings at publish. Client-supplied authorMembershipGeneration is never trusted. Leaving/rejoining increments generation so old post audience grants do not resurrect.

PostPatch.description: Replacing/removing attachment requires current post ETag and author rights validation. Replacement creates a new version-bound save policy; existing authorized copies of the old recipe persist unless recalled. Cannot supply attachment and removeAttachment=true together.

MediaPrepare.description: An exact owned upload intent. clientDraftId identifies an account-scoped local composer lifecycle; reserving media does not implicitly create a social PostDraft. Existing server-draft terminal or expiry state must fence upload eligibility under the same lifecycle lock. Different explicit media intents may share a draft, but retry keeps its original idempotency key and reservation. Configured photo format, byte and processing bounds are additional service policy, not permission to accept deferred clip/avatar flows.

protocol.description: Explicit signed-upload protocol selection. Omission preserves the historical versioned POST protocol. The selected protocol is retained with this exact reservation and cannot be changed by retry or completion.

Upload.description: Owned processing status. The unchanged id/version/createdAt/updatedAt/status core (and optional errorCode) is the only durable command result. A prepare response may add either all four historical POST capability fields or one explicitly tagged Supabase signed PUT uploadCapability, never both. Capabilities are ephemeral, excluded from receipts, and only issued for the original awaitingUpload version 1 reservation under current authorization. A core-only prepare recovery does not issue or renew a capability. Status GET and completion never issue capabilities. Upload or processing success does not grant delivery or publication rights.

UploadComplete.description: Exact completion intent for the durably selected reservation protocol. Historical untagged requests retain objectVersionId and sha256. Supabase signed-upload completion carries its explicit protocol and expected checksum, not an invented immutable provider version; the server independently resolves and verifies the reserved destination and content-bound inspection material. A provider path acknowledgement is not proof of readiness.

CircleInvitationAcceptance.description: Invitation-specific acceptance. Preserves all Member fields; circleId is the authorized consumed invitation target, not a membership ID or an authorization grant. General Member remains unchanged.

ThreadCreate.description: Direct recipient requires active permitted relationship/contact preferences. Pact/potluck participants are derived from accepted server memberships; client cannot provide arbitrary group recipient list.

socialDiscoveryVisible.description: Controls social UI presentation only, not object authorization or public discovery. publicDiscoveryEnabled remains false.
